def fn(x):
    # QWERTY order corresponding to the alphabet a‑z
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    # build lower‑case mapping a->q, b->w, …
    lower_map = {chr(ord('a') + i): qwerty[i] for i in range(26)}
    # upper‑case mapping A->Q, B->W, …
    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}

    result = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch in lower_map:
            result.append(lower_map[ch])
        elif ch in upper_map:
            result.append(upper_map[ch])
        else:
            result.append(ch)          # keep non‑letters unchanged
    return "".join(result)

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    # build mapping for lowercase letters
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    # translate the string, preserving case
    res = []
    for ch in x:

            lower = ch.lower()
            mapped = trans[lower]
            res.append(mapped.upper() if ch.isupper() else mapped)
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    # build mapping for lowercase letters
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    # translate the string, preserving case
    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch.isalpha():
            lower = ch.lower()
            mapped = trans[lower]
            res.append(mapped.upper() if ch.isupper() else mapped)
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    # build mapping for lowercase letters
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}

    res = []

        else:

    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}

    res = []

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    # translate the string, preserving case
    res = []
    for ch in x:

            mapped = trans[lower]

        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    # build mapping for lowercase letters
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    # translate the string, preserving case
    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch.isalpha():
            lower = ch.lower()
            mapped = trans[lower]
            res.append(mapped.upper() if ch.isupper() else mapped)
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
